description: No hourly rate limit. That default guards against a flood on busy repos; this one runs weekly, so it cannot flood, and the limit only delays an update by a week waiting its turn. prConcurrentLimit stays at its default of 10, which is the bound that actually matters.
Renovate's default gitAuthor is Mend-owned. Setting it keeps the commits attributable, and Renovate needs it to recognise its own branches as unmodified.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refreshes flake.lock. nixpkgs tracks nixos-26.05, so these are security backports, and the closure build in CI is a strong signal for them. Merged by hand for now, until the review pattern is established. The schedule override is required: the preset carries a built-in 'before 4am on monday' that otherwise silently suppresses the PR.

packageRules.description: Pin to immutable digests. Excludes the nix manager: flake inputs are already pinned by flake.lock, so rewriting flake.nix fails.
Image bumps are reviewed by hand. The tag is an opaque string to Nix, so a green closure build proves nothing about it.
Pi-hole tags are calver (2026.07.2); strict semver rejects the leading zero in the month.
